payload.core_mechanism_summary: Generates a set of 12 candidate strings by permuting blocks and repeating patterns, then checks each for absence of substrings s and t.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all possible valid arrangements as fixed patterns (6 periodic and 6 block-based permutations). It tests each candidate linearly. This is a form of complete search by manual permutation enumeration, not recursive backtracking.
